stemMd: The function $f(x)=(x-6)^2+11$ has a minimum value of what?
explanationMd: A square is nonnegative, and it is zero at x=6. Therefore the smallest possible output is 0+11=11. Vertex form makes the minimum immediate.

distractorRationale.b: This is the x-coordinate of the vertex.
distractorRationale.a: The vertical shift is upward, not downward.
distractorRationale.d: This is f(0), not the minimum.
